snippet.title: Mawkey The Last Macaw Second Trailer
snippet.description:
Mawkey: The Last Macaw is a 2D adventure about the last scarlet macaw, fighting to save Honduras from deforestation and greed. 🌿🔥

Support the project by downloading the demo on Itch.io and be part of this journey! 🎮✨

🐾 20% of future profits will be donated to animal shelters in Honduras.

🚀🌿✨ Mawkey The Last Macaw Needs Your Support! ✨🌿
I'm creating a video game that tells the story of Mawkey, the last scarlet macaw, on a journey to save Honduras’ forests. 🌎🔥 With unique art and a powerful message about conservation, I want this game to reach the world… but I need your help!
Support the project on Kickstarter and be part of this adventure: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mawkey/mawkey-tlm
Every pledge, every share, and every word of encouragement makes a difference. 🙌 Thank you for being part of this! ❤💛

🔗https://guerra-pixel-studios.itch.io/mawkey-the-last-macaw-demo
